about_the_game:
"Travel real distances, from Earth's atmosphere to the farthest stars in the universe"

🚀 In My Idle Space Cruiser, you’re launched toward the stars aboard your spaceship — initially quite modest. Luckily, they installed a photon collector plate! With the stored energy, you can upgrade your engine’s power, increase your photon collection range, and improve energy conversion efficiency.

🌌 As mentioned before, this game simulates the real distance to every object you may encounter on your interstellar journey, starting from planet Earth all the way to the far reaches of the cosmos. Pass by airplanes at 10,000 meters altitude, the Moon at 380,000 kilometers, Proxima Centauri at 4 light-years away… and much more.

💭 “So you mean if I upgrade my ship until it reaches the speed of light, I’ll have to leave the game open for 4 years to reach Proxima Centauri?”
Not exactly. Here, the laws of physics have been slightly bent, allowing you to surpass the speed of light. Just keep upgrading your ship to cross cosmic distances faster and faster.

📒 Every object you encounter along the way is recorded in your stellar logbook, along with an achievement and a fun fact about it.

❓ Curious to find out what awaits you at the ‘end’ of the universe?

Features

  • 🚀 Idle intergalactic journey – Watch your ship travel realistic cosmic distances, from planet Earth to the farthest stars.

  • 🎶 Relaxing lo-fi soundtrack – Calm, soothing music that turns your space journey into a moment of peace.

  • 🌌 Laid-back cosmic exploration – Enjoy the trip at your own pace, with no rush—just take in the vastness of space.

  • 📒 Stellar logbook – Record each discovery with fun facts and achievements about the objects you encounter.

  • 💡 Strategic upgrades – Improve your engine, photon collection range, and energy efficiency to travel faster and farther.

  • 🪐 Real-scale – Experience the actual distance to each planet, star, and point of cosmic interest.

  • 🛋 Perfect for relaxing – Play while studying, working, or unwinding; ideal for focus or peaceful downtime.

short_description: This game is a vertical desktop widget where you'll travel the actual distance of the entire known universe aboard your space cruiser. Is Proxima Centauri 4 light-years away? Then we'll travel 4 light-years
supported_languages: English, Portuguese - Brazil, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Russian
